text:
Sara (AE): Quick heads-up — AtlasGen (healthcare) wants a 3-month pilot to evaluate PHI use. They're asking for a 40% pilot rebate and guaranteed conversion to a 12‑mo committed plan after pilot. Pilot expected volume ~100M tokens/month. Also require SOC2 + HIPAA BA and private deployment. Need deal-desk guidance ASAP. @Luis @Michael @Bo :eyes:

Luis (Sales Ops): For pilots we typically cap rebates at 25% without an ARR commit. >25% requires VP sign-off and finance justification. Can you confirm list pricing and expected ARR if they convert? Also need the customer's logo and procurement timeline.

Michael (Finance): Finance can approve up to 30% only if customer signs a 12-month $240k annual commit (or equivalent committed GPU capacity). Otherwise recommend 20% + $50k pilot credit. 40% is above our typical bands — need ROI case.

Bo (Solutions Eng): Private deploy + HIPAA adds infra and ops cost. Ballpark: ~2 dedicated V100-equivalents plus on-call ops for pilot => ~$10k/month infra delta + 1 week setup. That should be accounted for in margin calc.

Hema (Legal): HIPAA BA required; we'll need customer-signed BAA and proof of controls. SOC2 report ok. If they want on-prem, legal review + security checklist (10 business days). Share the security questionnaire link.

Jen (CS): Customer champion says they're comfortable with a pilot but we must lock SSO + audit logs. I'll own runbook and acceptance criteria. Also confirm rollback policy if PHI ingestion concerns arise.

Luis (Sales Ops): Please file the deal-desk request form with these fields: customer name, expected ARR, pilot length (3mo), pilot tokens, security req (HIPAA), requested rebate %, and proposed convert terms. Quick quote snippet for reference:
```
List price: $0.015/token
Pilot volume: 100M tokens/mo
Pilot price before rebate: $1,500/mo
Requested pilot rebate: 40% => $900/mo
Finance counter: 20% or 30% with 12mo $240k commit
```

deal-bot: Auto-note — Deal-desk: discount requested 40%. System rule: auto-approve up to 25% for pilots. Anything above routes to VP Sales for manual approval.

Michael (Finance): If AE can get firm verbal conversion commitment and PO during pilot we can entertain 30% (finance sign-off required). Otherwise hold to 20% + pilot credit to cover infra.

Sara (AE): Got it. I'll push for 30% with the conversion commitment and escalate to VP Sales for a 40% exception if champion insists. Filing the form now + pinging procurement. Thanks all :thumbsup:
